mandatoryCriteria: Soft delete card: POST /api/v1/cards/:cardId/delete transitions card state from active to trashed
Administrator authorization: Only workspace owner or project manager can delete cards; members/viewers receive 403 FORBIDDEN
Restore window computation: Sets deleted_at = NOW(), deleted_by = actor.id, restore_until = NOW() + INTERVAL '24 hours'
Active board exclusion: Trashed cards immediately disappear from board snapshot, card search, and active counts
Board version update: Increments board structure_version and snapshot_version
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: Card soft-delete with 24-hour restore window.
